page.overview:
Who is Marius Alethea Blasco?

Marius Alethea Blasco was a Bene Gesserit Reverend Mother interested in Frederick IV's schemes on the fate of the spice, whose to be judged by the three Great Houses competing for it.

She contacted Lady Elara Moray Trieu to Arrakis in order to send her reports about the situation there.
